subject: Horizon Health — cost recap & next steps
messages:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Harrison <samantha.harrison@horizonhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Recap + preliminary cost model (post-call)

Thanks again for the call this morning — great conversation. Below is a concise recap of the assumptions we used for the preliminary cost model and next steps. I attached a working spreadsheet (horizon_cost_model_v1.xlsx) and a one-page summary (horizon_pricing_summary.pdf).

Key discovery points (as we heard them):
- Primary use case: discharge summaries + patient Q&A (mix of short + medium prompts).
- Expected steady-state (after initial ramp): ~45M tokens/mo.
- Launch / promotional peak: up to ~150M tokens/mo for 4–6 weeks.
- Desired latency: < 400 ms median for core flows; occasional longer tails acceptable.
- Security: must be able to run in VPC with customer-managed keys (we noted Private deployment interest).

Preliminary unit economics (two quick scenarios included in the sheet):
- Hosted (pay-as-you-go): unit price assumption in model = $1,000 per 1M tokens (net estimate); at 45M tokens => ~$45,000/mo.
- Dedicated (reserved capacity; 6–12 month commit): effective unit price in model range = $700–$850 per 1M tokens + monthly reserved baseline; at 45M tokens => ~$31,500–$38,250/mo (plus baseline reserved fee).

Line items and caveats in the spreadsheet: batching assumptions, expected KV cache hit rate (25–40%), model variant choices (mix of 13B for Q&A and 7B for short completions), and optional monitoring/observability add-ons. The summary PDF shows a 3-scenario view (steady, launch, peak).

Requested next items from your side to refine estimates:
1) Confirm steady-state monthly token estimate (45M is our working assumption).
2) Confirm whether you prefer Hosted vs Dedicated pricing (we can model both).
3) Procurement timeline / PO contact for a potential reserved commit.

Attaching: horizon_cost_model_v1.xlsx (Excel, 58KB); horizon_pricing_summary.pdf (PDF, 18KB).

Next steps I propose: I can send a short side-by-side invoice-style estimate for Hosted vs Dedicated by EOD tomorrow once you confirm volume preference. If helpful, we can also schedule a 30-min pricing walk-through.

Thanks,
Aisha
Aisha Rahman | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachment: horizon_cost_model_v1.xlsx (Excel spreadsheet, 58KB)
Attachment: horizon_pricing_summary.pdf (PDF, 18KB)

From: Samantha Harrison <samantha.harrison@horizonhealth.com>

Date: 2026-06-03T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap + preliminary cost model (post-call)

Thanks Aisha — this is helpful. A few clarifications from our side:
- Steady-state is likely closer to 60M tokens/month for the first 3 months while we iterate on prompts, then we expect a drop to ~45M after optimization. So please model both 60M and 45M.
- Peak: we could see short spikes to 200M tokens during a marketing push (1–2 weeks), so include a peak scenario.
- Budget: our procurement team has signaled an initial monthly budget range of $40k–$75k depending on whether reserved discounts apply and how much work is needed for Private deployment.
- Target unit economics: ideally <$900 per 1M tokens net; leadership will consider up to ~$1,100 for Hosted if latency/SLOs are guaranteed.

Procurement: I copied Tom Li (our procurement lead). He needs a line-item estimate and a simple T&Cs summary to start the PO process.

Can you provide:
1) Two invoice-style pages (Hosted vs Dedicated) for 45M and 60M steady scenarios plus the 200M peak summary.
2) A one-page note on what Redwood would require for a short POC (timeline, data handling, technical contact).

Happy to hop on a 20-min sync; I’m available Friday morning PT.

Best,
Samantha
Samantha Harrison
Director, Digital Experience — Horizon Health

Got it. Quick notes:
- I ran the numbers in the pricing calc (linked): with our standard reserved baseline (4x RTX equivalent pool) the blended unit comes to ~$760 per 1M at 45M tokens, ~$700 per 1M at 60M, and ~$640 per 1M if they commit to 12 months and 150M/mo.
- Hosted pay-as-you-go estimate sits around $980 per 1M in the model (includes monitoring and streaming).
- Big lever to improve economics: increase caching (we can feasibly push cache hit to 40% with prompt engineering) and allow 7B model for short completions. That drives down the active GPU-hours materially.

I attached a short calc export to my reply (pricing_calc_export.csv) and I linked the working Drive folder in HubSpot. For the invoice pages I’ll draft two short PDFs and drop them into the Drive folder by EOD.
